summary: Practise crop-trial interpretation, selection indices and line advancement. Explore advanced plant breeding training and plan your next breeding cycle.
lede: Plant breeding improves crop populations through selection and crossing, guided by trait and trial evidence. For plant breeders and crop scientists, this training supports decisions about which lines to advance through trial-data assessment with BLUP, selection-index construction and interpretation of genotype-by-environment patterns.
audienceIntro: This course suits advanced practitioners who make or support decisions across crop-breeding pipelines, from trial evaluation and parent selection to seed-line advancement. It is designed for professionals with prior exposure to plant genetics or breeding records.
modules: Breeding Pipeline Review and Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior experience with plant breeding, crop genetics or interpretation of agricultural trial records is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use breeding scenarios and spreadsheet-based calculations.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
